items.problem: A `DataTemplate` that uses `x:Bind` must declare `x:DataType`; without it the XAML compiler emits WMC1111 'DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType to be specified using x:DataType'. The skill covers x:Bind generally but never states this DataTemplate requirement.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl line 16628 includes 'error WMC1111: DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType to be specified using x:DataType'.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### `x:Bind` and compiled bindings' (line ~738) — states x:Bind is supported with the same syntax and mentions XLS0414/MC3074, but does not mention the DataTemplate x:DataType requirement or WMC1111.
items.proposed_improvement: Add one sentence to the existing '`x:Bind` and compiled bindings' section: any `DataTemplate` that uses `x:Bind` must carry `x:DataType="local:Type"` (WMC1111 if missing), and that DataType type must be resolvable via the `local:` xmlns — a frequent casualty of the SDKTemplate namespace mismatch.
items.generalizes: x:Bind inside item templates is ubiquitous in SDK-sample scenario lists and any list/collection UI; stating the x:DataType requirement prevents WMC1111 across scenarios.
